Name: Haley's Hairstyles
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE 2.0.0 Thank you to AirynS for helping me with making this update work! I couldn't have done it without his help!!! NOW WHEN YOU DOWNLOAD THIS MOD, YOU WILL HAVE ALL 6 HAIRSTYLES IN YOUR GAME! Just go to your Generic Mod Configure Menu and choose which style you'd like to have for beach/regular/winter portraits, and change them anytime you'd like within the GMCM !!!

[size=4]I made this [url=https://youtu.be/kyR9d2IHKEw]Youtube video[/url] showcasing this mod! <3 I'd love if you checked it out and told me what you think!!! xoxo[/size]

[size=5]IMPORTANT!!![/size][size=4] This is a PORTRAIT ONLY mod (so far). 
IMPORTANT!!! if one of the options isn't showing up for you, when the box in GMCM comes up to choose which hairstyle you'd like, scroll up! Then you should be able to see all hair options!!!
[/size][size=5]IMPORTANT!!! [/size][size=3]No more choosing just one style, with update 2.0.0 (thank you AirynS!) you can now download just one file, and all of the hairstyles will be contained within it. As you can see in the final image above, in your Game Mod Configure Menu, you can toggle which hairstyles you'd like for each type (beach/regular/winter). This is a huge update as now you can easily switch between hairstyles for Haley (which is exactly what she deserves <3)[/size][size=4]

[/size][size=3]HOW TO INSTALL: (CONTENT PATCHER VERSION)
1. ensure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. download the main file
3. unzip file into your 'Mods' folder
4. Launch Stardew and configure the hairstyle that you'd like to use in "GMCM" or Generic Mod Configure Menu 
Haley will now have her cute new hairstyles!!! 

WHAT ARE YOUR OPTIONS?
[/size]Haley can have a braid, a braid with a flower, a high bun, a high bun with earrings, space buns, or space buns with clips <3 <3

[size=3]LIKE MY MODS? THIS IS WHAT IS COMING NEXT!
-beds mod to match the vibe/colour story of my "Cute Rugs" mod! 
-Berserk inspired character replacement portraits and sprites
-Black Butler inspired character replacement portraits and sprites
-CUTE frog related content. Lots is coming, but I think this next one you will particularly enjoy <3
